question: Should acpx reserve `pool` as a stable built-in agent keyword whose default command is `pool acp`?
rationale: The code and proof establish that the command works today, but registry names and defaults are long-lived user-facing conventions under the repository policy and cannot be selected safely by automated review alone.

options.title: Approve the built-in mapping
options.body: Adopt `pool -> pool acp` as a supported stable registry contract and merge the synchronized implementation and documentation.

options.title: Choose a different stable name
options.body: Keep the integration but require a different keyword before merge if `pool` is too generic or conflicts with the desired registry vocabulary.

options.title: Keep it configuration-only
options.body: Decline a core built-in and direct users to define the installed Poolside command in their local acpx configuration.

recommendation.title: Approve the built-in mapping
recommendation.body: Adopt `pool -> pool acp` as a supported stable registry contract and merge the synchronized implementation and documentation.
